europe_now.title: Poland Charges Individuals with Russian Espionage
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities have charged two Ukrainian nationals with conducting spying and sabotage operations on behalf of Russia. The arrests highlight ongoing regional security concerns and heightened intelligence threats in Central Europe.

sources.headline: Two Ukrainians charged with spying and sabotage for Russia in Poland

europe_now.title: Fatal Highway Incident in Bulgaria
europe_now.summary: A major highway pileup in Bulgaria has resulted in twelve fatalities and left dozens of individuals injured. The prime minister confirmed the severe casualties resulting from the catastrophic traffic collision.

sources.headline: Bulgaria highway pileup kills 12, dozens injured: PM

top_stories.title: Ukraine Peace Negotiations
top_stories.summary: Representatives from the United States, Russia, and Ukraine have convened in Abu Dhabi to restart peace negotiations. Concurrently, European and American officials have agreed to review postwar continental security arrangements as the diplomatic talks progress.

sources.headline: Europe and US agree to review postwar continental security as Ukraine talks begin
US, Russia and Ukraine to restart talks in Abu Dhabi

top_stories.title: Cyberattack and Sabotage Response
top_stories.summary: French authorities have vowed to implement a robust response following a supermarket freezer cyberattack attributed to Iran. This incident coincides with broader regional investigations into foreign interference and sabotage activities across Europe.
